title: PaperCertiMetadata
description: Schema for generating an agency-grade Archival Luxury Academic Publication Proof & Certification website.

paper_title.description: Full formal title of the scientific paper

authors_line_html.description: HTML snippet of author list with superscripts (e.g., 'Purva Chordia<sup>1*</sup>, Madhuri Gahlod<sup>2*</sup>')

lead_author_name.description: Plain text name of the primary author / researcher

affiliations_html.description: HTML block of institutional affiliations with superscript indicators

corresponding_authors_html.description: HTML line for corresponding author emails and primary DOI link

journal_emblem_letter.description: Single letter emblem for header/avatar seal (e.g. 'J')

journal_issue_subtitle.description: Sub-header banner string under journal name

journal_url.description: Official URL link to current issue or paper on journal website

journal_domain_display.description: Display text for journal domain link in top bar (e.g. 'journal.uny.ac.id ↗')

publisher_name.description: University, Academic Press, or Publishing House

organizer_name.description: Department, Faculty, or Academic Organizing body

country_name.description: Country where the journal is published (e.g. 'Indonesia')

country_name_upper.description: Uppercase country name for header badges (e.g. 'INDONESIA')

location_stat.description: City and country pill stat (e.g. '📍 Yogyakarta, Indonesia')

doi_text.description: Formatted DOI URL text displayed on screen

indexing_val.description: Academic indexing bodies (e.g. 'Google Scholar, Scopus, SINTA')

verification_banner_text.description: Official verification statement highlighted in right bento card

seal_code.description: 3-6 letter code embossed inside the golden wax seal (e.g. 'JBSAC')

article_dates_html.description: HTML list of editorial milestones (Received, Revised, Accepted, Published)

first_page_table_html.description: Primary preview table placed directly inside the pinned paper sheet

caption_authors_html.description: Author line with mentor/guide credit below sheet

tab2_cards_grid_html.description: Comparative cards grid HTML for batches, models, or experimental variants

tab2_benchmark_html.description: Commercial or theoretical benchmark comparison card HTML

tab3_steps_grid_html.description: Numbered step cards grid HTML (1 to 6 steps)

tab3_visualizer_html.description: Side-by-side or pipeline diagram box HTML

achievement_avatar_letter.description: Single initial letter for author avatar circle (e.g. 'P')

achievement_title.description: Headline for Achievement Unlocked climax card

achievement_tag.description: Badge tag (e.g. '3rd Year Student', 'Lead Researcher', 'PhD Candidate')

achievement_lead_p.description: Summarizing lead paragraph for portfolio showcase

editorial_modal_details_html.description: HTML lines inside the Editorial Verification popup modal

legal_disclaimer.description: Footer legal and academic copyright notice
